flags.why: The common verbal meaning of holding someone's hand is missing.
flags.fix: verb | to hold someone's hand; ex: Mẹ cầm tay con qua đường. = The mother holds her child's hand while crossing the road.

flags.why: The example explains what leopard style is instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Anh ấy đang tập báo quyền. = He is practising leopard-style kung fu.

flags.why: Bạ lấy is unnatural here because bạ expresses indiscriminate action rather than grabbing ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-b%E1%BA%A1)).
flags.fix: Đừng bạ gì cũng bỏ vào miệng. = Don't put just anything into your mouth.

flags.why: Nhược tiểu normally describes small, weak nations rather than a person's puny physique ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/nh%C6%B0%E1%BB%A3c_ti%E1%BB%83u)).
Using nhược tiểu to describe a boy's physical build is unnatural.
flags.fix: Các nước nhược tiểu dễ bị các cường quốc lấn át. = Small, weak nations are easily dominated by major powers.

flags.why: Quạu quọ is mainly Southern usage and needs a regional tag ([source](https://baovannghe.vn/mot-cay-but-mo-duong-cho-the-loai-truyen-ngan-o-nam-bo-4954.html)).
